comment: Three CHK switches for four slots: each chokes the slot to its right, so the last slot has none. A slot whose TRG jack is empty is short-circuited to 0V at Drummer4Plus.cpp:121 and the matching test in each other slot. The level CVs are read inside the rising-edge block, so they are sampled per hit rather than continuously.
